MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Christmas Voices feels like a natural next choice because its title suggests vocal Christmas music, connecting directly with my repeated holiday listening.",
    "Christmas Made For Two and Buon Natale: The Christmas Album fit the clear Christmas theme in my history; The Perfect Gift feels potentially relevant, though I am less certain about it."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "A Broadway cast recording or a Willie Nelson retrospective does not connect with what I want to sample on this visit.",
    "How Great Is Our God does not appeal just because Christmas music can have religious themes; I have not shown a broader interest in worship collections.",
    "Titles such as Voyage, Stages, and The Definitive Collection give me too little evidence of a connection to my listening to make me choose them."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The choices seem to stretch my interest in Christmas albums into an interest in music collections generally, but being a collection is not what draws me in.",
    "The worship recommendation seems to treat holiday listening as evidence that I also want religious music outside that holiday context."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated Christmas listening gives me a concrete reason to consider another holiday album, but my later interaction with The New Old Fashioned leaves my current interest less certain.",
    "I rarely choose something without a clear connection to my interests. Even among the Christmas albums, I would sample only Christmas Voices this visit rather than try every plausible match."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my holiday listening, but stretched it into broader musical interests that do not give me a clear reason to choose anything now."
}
